title: Use positive Markov forests only after the actual Schur elimination
statement: For the specified shell 0..N,N>=4 with killing (a)_3 and common (B)_4 removed, the coarse Green norm is <=C N^12. Adding C has an exact Schur complement retaining HALF the new-endpoint return rate and extra killing 7N(N-1)/2; positive Markov forests give same-index neighboring ratios between c/(N+1) and C(N+1). Adding A aligns the actual endpoint zeros, incurs extra killing 6 at old a=2 and a forest factor C N^4. The old coarse diagonal bound gives the valid but loose shifted exponent D=16. Positivity is earned for this exact killed Markov structure, not arbitrary tilted Metzler coefficients or a norm-to-entry Harnack shortcut.
